name: hindsight
one_liner: A memory system that lets AI agents remember what worked and what didn't across many conversations, so they get smarter with use instead of forgetting everything each session.
buyer: A startup building a customer-facing AI chatbot or agent product who needs it to remember prior interactions per customer without building memory infrastructure themselves.
business_use_cases: A customer support AI vendor plugs it in so the bot remembers a returning customer's past issues instead of asking them to repeat themselves.
An AI sales-assistant SaaS uses it to let its agent recall what pitches worked for similar leads and improve its scripts over time.
A personal AI coach app stores what advice a user acted on versus ignored, to tailor future suggestions.

money_ideas.idea: Managed cloud memory-as-a-service billed by stored memories or API calls.
Integration consulting for AI product teams wiring memory into an existing agent stack.

steal_this: Bolt it onto an existing support chatbot this weekend and demo 'it remembers you now' as a paid upgrade tier.
